heading: Tuesday Night
text: Partly cloudy south. Partly to mostly cloudy north, with the slight chance of a shower from the northern Greens westward. Lows mainly in the 50s, with some upper 40s in the cooler hollows, and some lower 60s in the Champlain Valley. South winds around 5 mph in areas east of the Greens, 5 to 10 mph in the west, and gusting to 25 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Wednesday
text: Partly cloudy. Highs in the low to mid 70s, mid to upper 70s southeast, and in the broad valleys west. Winds from the south at 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Wednesday Night
text: Partly cloudy. Lows from the mid 50s to lower 60s, some lower 50s far north. Winds becoming light, variable to north.
